folds.title: Plan, then build
points: Big changes go better in two steps: **plan**, then **build**.
Planning first lets you catch a wrong direction while it is still cheap to fix.

folds.title: Not sure yet?
points: Ask Claude to interview you until it could write a spec.
Save that spec to a file.
Then start a fresh session to build from it.

folds.title: Interview first

chat.you: I want a booking page. Interview me until you could write a spec, then save it to `spec.md`.

chat.claude: Happy to. First question: who will be booking, and what are they booking?

folds.note: Then build from the spec in a fresh session.

folds.title: Review in plan mode
points: Switch to **plan mode** to review before anything changes.
Claude reads files and proposes a plan.
It makes no edits until you approve.

folds.title: Give it a check
points: Give Claude a way to check its own work, such as tests to run.
Without a check, it may say it is done when it is not.

folds.title: Steer early
points: Watch the first minute, and press `Esc` if Claude drifts.
Small changes in plain steps need no plan.
